question_en: Broker: the client wants to improve as a skipper during the charter with the professional skipper on board. Can the skipper teach him and let him helm?

In this case, the full security deposit applicable to the yacht would need to be provided, as our professional skipper would not assume responsibility for any potential damage caused during the charter. His role would instead be purely advisory and supportive, assisting [client] whenever necessary. Alternatively, if our professional skipper remains responsible for the handling and navigation of the yacht, [client] may certainly be involved and participate during the sailing, depending on the skipper's assessment and the circumstances at the time. However, please note that our professional skipper would not be acting as a sailing instructor. While he may share his experience and provide guidance, allowing [client] to participate where appropriate, we cannot guarantee that he can provide formal instructions or allow [client] to take over the navigation of the yacht.

Within 120 days of embarkation: the amount paid will be retained by the company, subject to the Rebooking Guarantee (Credit Policy): if your cancelled yacht is successfully rebooked by another client under the exact same terms (period, price, and conditions), the amount you have paid will be converted into a credit for a future charter booking with us. Credit Validity: this credit must be used for a new charter starting no later than October 30th of the following year. Credits are non-transferable and cannot be redeemed for cash.

question_en: (Implied in offer) How does the security deposit work and can it be insured?
answer_exact:
SECURITY DEPOSIT: OPTION A: Independent Deposit Insurance & Refundable security deposit. You have the option to secure full coverage for your security deposit by purchasing insurance from an independent insurance company. The insurance must be completed BEFORE arrival. You can insure your deposit through Yachtpool, Hamburg, Fairwinds or any other insurance company. The refundable amount based on yacht's specification is normally withheld on spot.
OPTION B: Damage Waiver (On-Arrival Option). If you arrive without independent insurance, the only available option is to purchase a Damage Waiver through YachtPool, which includes: a non-refundable fee (calculated based on the yacht's specifications) and a refundable deposit that is held in case of damage. You retain the option to insure the refundable portion on the spot.

question_en: I do not understand the VISA pre-authorisation form. Is 50% of the security deposit pre-authorised, and how and when do I pay the rest?

As you will have a professional skipper from our company, the required security deposit is reduced by 50%. This is because the skipper will be responsible for the navigation of the yacht, the sailing decisions and the overall safety of the vessel and the guests during the charter. You will, of course, remain responsible for the proper use and condition of the yacht, including the interior areas and any damages caused to the vessel or its equipment.

Finally, regarding the security deposit, there is no need to provide or send us your card details in advance. The reduced security deposit amount will simply be pre-authorised on your credit or debit card upon your arrival and check-in. The amount is temporarily blocked on your card rather than being charged, and it will be released accordingly after the yacht is returned and the necessary checks have been completed, provided that there are no damages or outstanding amounts. It will take like 5 to 10 working days to appear back to your account.

Therefore, at this stage, the only payment you need to arrange in advance is the charter deposit. The remaining extras and the security deposit will be handled upon your arrival.

question_en: What would be the duties of a cook and hostess?
answer_exact:
If you would like to have crew on board, the costs are €1,500 for the skipper, €1,330 for the hostess, or €1,610 for the cook, excluding their meals.

The skipper is responsible for your safety, the yacht's operation, monitoring weather conditions, and suggesting possible destinations. He will recommend suitable ports, bays, and sailing routes, allowing you to choose according to your preferences, always weather permitting.

The hostess will assist you upon embarkation and help you become familiar with the yacht. Her duties include grocery shopping and organizing supplies, preparing breakfast and lunch, maintaining cleanliness in the common areas, disposing of rubbish at ports, providing easy access to snacks, drinks and ice throughout the day, and assisting the skipper during mooring or whenever required for yacht-related tasks. Please note that the hostess' working hours generally end in the evening, except when yacht operations, such as mooring or rubbish disposal, require her assistance.

If you prefer to have a cook instead of a hostess, the cook's duties include menu planning and recommendations according to your preferences, grocery shopping and organizing all necessary supplies before arrival and during the week, preparation of breakfast, lunch and dinner (with dinner served no later than 20:00), ensuring easy access to beverages and light snacks throughout the day, and keeping the galley clean and tidy after meal preparation. Please note that guests are expected to assist the skipper during mooring.

question_en: What does a night in a port cost on average? May I drive the dinghy myself in the evening (I have a boat licence)? Do you have an airport shuttle and what does it cost? Photos of dinghy, kayak, seascooter?
answer_exact:
Mooring costs depend on your itinerary and the locations you visit, as there are no large marinas in the Ionian. Many stops in the Ionian are in small harbours and bays. Some waterfront restaurants offer complimentary mooring on the condition that you dine at their restaurant, while other locations charge approximately €20-€100 per night. At these smaller ports, berths generally operate on a first-come, first-served basis, rather than accepting advance reservations.
As a general policy, the skipper handles all onboard equipment, including the dinghy.
We do not operate our own airport shuttle service, but we work with a transport company and would be happy to arrange your transfer through them. The current transfer rates from Preveza Airport (PVK) are as follows: Lefkas - Aktio (PVK) Taxi (Capacity 4 pax) € 50.00; Van (Capacity 5-8 pax) € 85.00; Mini Bus (Capacity 16 pax) € 150.00. These are this year's rates. If prices change for next year, we will let you know when confirming your transfer.
I do not currently have photos of the dinghy, but I will try to obtain some once the boat returns on Friday. There is no need to decide on these extras just yet; you can confirm them shortly before your arrival.

[...] A large part of our technical operations is handled in-house. We have our own shipyard, where our technical team takes care of the maintenance, preparation and winterisation of our yachts. question_en: Can you hold the option until next Tuesday? We arrive in the morning, so what is the earliest we can board? When must we return the boat on the last day? Are we at your port on the first and last evening, with the skipper on board? Does the skipper take us ashore when at anchor?

I took the initiative to place a non-binding option on the yacht for you, in order to secure its availability until Tuesday. [...] without the Early Check-in service, as is also the case with most charter companies, the latest standard embarkation time is 17:00. Of course, we always do our very best to have the yacht ready and enable you to embark as early as possible.
[later] As mentioned, the latest boarding time is 17:00. However, this does not mean that you cannot board earlier if the yacht is ready before that time. Of course, we also offer an early check-in service, which allows you to board by 14:00 at the latest. This service is available at an additional cost of €170. All our yachts return to our base on Friday, no later than 16:00, so the check-out procedure can begin. Of course, you remain on board, and the actual disembarkation takes place on Saturday by 09:00. On the first day, Saturday, you are free to leave the port and start your trip; you do not need to stay in the harbour unless the weather conditions are not good. The skipper remains on board, as he will throughout the rest of the week. [...] when you are anchored, the skipper can take you to shore if you would like to go for dinner.

question_en: Interest in an RYA Day Skipper course in October, with Competent Crew not formally completed. Can she go straight to Day Skipper in one week, what does it cost, and what is the schedule?
answer_exact: Thank you for your interest in our services. It would be our pleasure to be part of your RYA journey. I would like to clarify that successfully completing the RYA Day Skipper course within one week requires you to already have basic sailing knowledge and practical experience, even if you have not formally completed the Competent Crew certification. This includes areas such as helming, sail handling, knots, safety procedures, and general life on board. If you feel confident that you have already covered these areas, then you may proceed directly with the Day Skipper course over one week. We currently have availability for your preferred dates. The cost is €1,050 per week, per person, based on shared cabin accommodation. Typical Flow: Sunday 18th (17:00): Arrival, accommodation, briefing. Monday-Friday: Daily sailing, training, island stops. Saturday: Final session + departure around midday. During the week, you'll sail approximately 100 nautical miles, including night sailing, while visiting destinations such as Aegina, Poros, Hydra, and Epidavros. Furthermore, in order to undertake the RYA Day Skipper course, you should also possess the theoretical knowledge required for this level. If you have not already acquired this knowledge through previous training or experience, you can complete the theory component online via a dedicated learning platform. The standard cost of the online theory course is €290.

question_en: The Day Skipper course destinations (Aegina, Poros, Hydra) are in the Aegean. I thought you are based in Lefkas and offer the course in the Ionian Sea. Can you clarify?
answer_exact: Our main base for the RYA courses is in Athens, specifically in Nea Peramos. This is where we conduct all our RYA courses together with Ionian Mode. However, Ionian Mode also has a base in Lefkada, specifically in Sivota. I would need to check with them whether they have any availability there for the dates you are interested in. question_en: I am interested in something similar to the RYA Coastal Skipper (course around 17 October).

Κύριε [client],

Η μόνη διαθέσιμη ημερομηνία για το RYA Coastal Skipper είναι από 25/10 έως 01/11 στη Λευκάδα.

Για να μπορέσει κάποιος να ολοκληρώσει με επιτυχία το συγκεκριμένο course, συνήθως χρειάζεται να έχει: περίπου 300 ναυτικά μίλια, περίπου 15 ημέρες εμπειρίας στη θάλασσα, προηγούμενη εμπειρία ως skipper, εμπειρία σε νυχτερινή ιστιοπλοΐα.

Από τη στιγμή που έχετε ήδη την απαιτούμενη εμπειρία, μπορείτε να προχωρήσετε απευθείας στο συγκεκριμένο course.

Το κόστος είναι €1.050, σε κοινόχρηστη καμπίνα.

Παραμένω στη διάθεσή σας για οποιαδήποτε πληροφορία ή διευκρίνιση χρειαστείτε.

question_en: I have everything except night sailing. How much extra is it to have the cabin to myself?
answer_exact:
Καλημέρα κύριε [client],

Από τη στιγμή που δεν έχετε εμπειρία σε νυχτερινή ιστιοπλοΐα, δυστυχώς δεν μπορείτε να προχωρήσετε απευθείας με το RYA Coastal Skipper.

Αυτό που θα μπορούσα να σας προτείνω είναι, για τις ίδιες ημερομηνίες, να παρακολουθήσετε το RYA Day Skipper course, μαζί με το θεωρητικό του μέρος.

[...] θα έχετε την ευκαιρία να καλύψετε και θέματα που πιθανώς δεν γνωρίζετε ήδη, να κάνετε τουλάχιστον 100 ναυτικά μίλια και, φυσικά, να αποκτήσετε εμπειρία σε night sailing.
Typical Flow:
- Sunday (17:00): Arrival & briefing
- Monday–Friday: Sailing, navigation & skippering
- Saturday: Final session & departure

Η τιμή του πρακτικού course είναι €1.050, ενώ το θεωρητικό μέρος κοστίζει κανονικά €290 και μπορεί να πραγματοποιηθεί online πριν την άφιξή σας.

Η παραπάνω τιμή αφορά διαμονή σε shared cabin. Εάν επιθυμείτε single cabin, υπάρχει επιπλέον χρέωση 50% επί της τιμής του course.

Τέλος, εφόσον ολοκληρώσετε το Day Skipper, από τον Μάρτιο, όταν ανοίξει ξανά η βάση μας, θα μπορείτε να προχωρήσετε και στο RYA Coastal Skipper course, έχοντας πλέον αποκτήσει και την απαιτούμενη εμπειρία νυχτερινής ιστιοπλοΐας.

OPTION B: Damage Waiver (On-Arrival Option). If you arrive without independent insurance, the only available option is to purchase a Damage Waiver through YachtPool, which includes: a non-refundable fee (calculated based on the yacht's specifications) and a refundable deposit that is held in case of damage. When the yacht is at anchor, however, the skipper will generally need to remain on board. In addition, as the dinghy is part of the yacht's equipment, it should be operated by the skipper. Finally, regarding gratuity, this is entirely at your discretion and should reflect your satisfaction with the service provided. As a general guideline, a tip of approximately 5–10% is customary, although this is by no means fixed or obligatory.

question_en: Is 17:00 the only boarding time? When do we hand the boat back on the last day? Do we stay in the port the first and last evening, and is the skipper on board? If at anchor, does the skipper take us ashore for dinner and pick us up?

All our yachts return to our base on Friday, no later than 16:00, so the check-out procedure can begin. Of course, you remain on board, and the actual disembarkation takes place on Saturday by 09:00. On the first day, Saturday, you are free to leave the port and start your trip; you do not need to stay in the harbour unless the weather conditions are not good. The skipper remains on board, as he will throughout the rest of the week. ... when you are anchored, the skipper can take you to shore if you would like to go for dinner. He will most likely stay ashore as well ... If he returns to the yacht, he will of course come and pick you up whenever you are ready.

question_en: What are the security deposit and insurance options?
answer_exact:
OPTION A: Independent Deposit Insurance & Refundable Security Deposit. You have the option to secure full coverage for your security deposit by purchasing insurance from an independent insurance company. The insurance must be arranged before your arrival. You can insure your deposit through Yacht-Pool, Hamburg, Fairwinds, or any other insurance company. The refundable amount, which depends on the yacht's specifications, is normally held on-site.

OPTION B: Damage Waiver (On-Arrival Option). If you arrive without independent insurance, the available option is to purchase a Damage Waiver through Yacht-Pool, which includes: a non-refundable fee, calculated according to the yacht's specifications, and a refundable deposit, which is held in case of any damage. You also have the option to insure the refundable portion on the spot.

question_en: Can you run RYA Day Skipper (me) and Competent Crew (my husband) concurrently on the same yacht, around 24-31 October? Do you offer the Day Skipper theory online?
answer_exact:
Both you and your husband can indeed take the courses you mentioned, with the two courses running concurrently on the same yacht.

RYA Competent Crew: the first-level course, designed to turn complete beginners into confident crew members (sail handling, helming, anchoring, mooring, safety procedures and general yacht operations).

RYA Day Skipper Practical: for sailors who want to skipper a yacht during daytime passages (boat handling, navigation, pilotage, safety, passage planning, skipper responsibilities).

Since you already have sailing experience, you can also proceed directly to the Day Skipper course, provided that you feel confident with the required practical skills and knowledge.

For the Day Skipper course, you will also need to have completed the theory component. ... you can complete the theory course online through a dedicated learning platform. The standard cost of the online theory course is 290 EUR.

Essentially, you can choose any of the yachts included in the offer below and, on top of the yacht price, we can arrange an instructor at a cost of 2,400 EUR, excluding VAT and food.

However, since this is a last-minute request and this week is also the final week of operation at our base, I need a little time to confirm an instructor's availability for these dates.

Crewed vessels require an APA (Advance Provisioning Allowance) for fuel, provisioning, onboard supplies and port/marina fees. Crew manages it with receipts, unused balance is returned at the end. APA is paid partly by bank transfer (advance 2,500 EUR) and the rest on embarkation, because many ports require local payment. Skipper duties: safe operation, weather, navigation, proposing itineraries. Hostess duties: provisions, breakfast and lunch (2 meals), cleaning of interior common areas and exterior lounge daily, snacks/drinks/ice, assisting with mooring; working hours end in the evening.
